abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Cardivel lowers systolic drop compared with Standard care. Overall, Cardivel lowers blood pressure control compared with Standard care.
conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Cardivel lowers systolic drop compared with Standard care. Overall, Cardivel lowers blood pressure control compared with Standard care.
section:
### Additional comparison

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. This comparison was run at the Harbor Street Patients.

Table 7. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.
